verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents card-level spend limits and caps with reset intervals, embedded expense policies, and declines reported via webhooks, which together show automatic enforcement per card or employee. Department-level budgets appear only as a one-line marketing mention of "departmental budget controls", with no detail on how those budgets are set or enforced. Missing for 10: documented department/program budget objects, evidence that budget-level limits (rather than per-card caps) are automatically enforced, program-budget support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
